name: Utopia
placementTarget: The board, over the Lake Baikal area of the Utopia region. The sticker is the only sticker card in the package.
text:
Open 22
the first time
you move to
Lake Baikal.

Utopia

40° N
100° E

[blue square with a white 8]
[red city marker with a white cross]
[one black route line leaving the marker toward the bottom-right edge]

mechanics.timing: The first time you move to Lake Baikal, open door 22.
mechanics.effect: Places the red city Utopia on the board. Starting population is the blue square with 8. A latitude line is labeled 40° N and a longitude line is labeled 100° E. One thick black route starts at the Utopia city marker and leaves the sticker through the bottom-right edge. No second city, haven, or route is drawn on this sticker.
restrictions: Door 22 opens the first time you move to Lake Baikal. The city name printed on the sticker is Utopia, and Lake Baikal is named only in that instruction.
The Player card gives Utopia's coordinates as 41°45'10"N 111°31'60"E. The sticker's 40° N and 100° E are grid lines, not that coordinate pair.
The city marker is red. The population square is blue. No infested symbol, anchor, or recon diamond is printed on the sticker.
The other end of the black route is not labeled on this sticker.
